Present Simple odatlar, takrorlanadigan ishlar va umumiy faktlarni bildiradi. Bu ayni hozir bo‘layotgan ishni ifodalash uchun emas.

items.text:
I study English. — Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.
You study English. — Siz ingliz tilini o‘rganasiz.
We work. — Biz ishlaymiz. They live in Tashkent. — Ular Toshkentda yashaydilar.
I, you, we, they bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shilmaydi. I am study emas, I study.

I play basketball every day. → We play basketball every day.
I read in the library. → They read in the library.
Every day — har kuni. In the morning — ertalab.
To Be bilan farqi: I am a student — kimman? I study English — nima qilaman?

items.text:
Ben reads in the library. — Ben kutubxonada o‘qiydi.
Emma rides a bike. — Emma velosiped haydaydi.
I read. → He reads. We work. → She works.
He, she, it yoki bitta odamning ismi bilan tasdiq gapda fe’lga odatda -s qo‘shiladi.

Ko‘p fe’llar: read → reads, play → plays.
-s, -sh, -ch, -x bilan tugaganlar: wash → washes, watch → watches, fix → fixes.
Go → goes; do → does. Undosh + y: study → studies. Unli + y: play → plays.
Have alohida: I have a book. → She has a book.

My sister studies English. — Singlim ingliz tilini o‘rganadi.
My friends study English. — Do‘stlarim ingliz tilini o‘rganadilar.
He goes to school. He does homework after class.

items.text:
Maya: I drink tea. I do not drink coffee.
Ben: My sister likes tea. She does not like coffee.
Do not = don’t. Does not = doesn’t. Ikkala shakl ham to‘g‘ri.
Inkor gap biror ish yoki odat mavjud emasligini bildiradi.

I / you / we / they + don’t + fe’l.
He / she / it + doesn’t + fe’l.
She likes tea. → She doesn’t like tea.
-s belgisi does ichida bor, shuning uchun doesn’t likes emas, doesn’t like.

We work on Mondays. We don’t work on Sundays.
He drives a car. He doesn’t drive a bus.
She has a bike. → She doesn’t have a bike.
I am not tired — holat. I don’t work at night — harakat/odat.

items.text:
Maya: Do you study English?
Ben: Yes, I do.
Maya: Does Emma take the bus?
Ben: No, she doesn’t. She rides a bike.
Do / does savol boshiga o‘tadi.

Do + I / you / we / they + fe’l?
Does + he / she / it + fe’l?
You work. → Do you work? She works. → Does she work?
Does she works? noto‘g‘ri. Does dan keyin asosiy fe’l.

Ben: I study in the library.
Maya: When does Emma ride her bike?
Ben: She rides her bike before class.
Savol so‘zi + do / does + ega + asosiy fe’l?

items.prompt: ___ do you study? — In the library.

items.text:
How often do you play basketball? — I play twice a week.
Always — har doim; usually — odatda; sometimes — ba’zan; never — hech qachon.
I usually read after breakfast. She never drinks coffee.
Bu ravishlar odatda asosiy fe’ldan oldin: usually read. To Be dan keyin: She is always busy. Never o‘zi inkor: don’t never demang.
